text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r m-o-d-e-l-e-d the c-a-s-e r-e-c-o-r-d as a n-o-t-e for p-l-a-n-n-i-n-g p-u-r-p-o-s-e s o that no a-c-t-i-v-e s-y-s-t-e-m was t-a-r-g-e-t-e-d d-u-r-i-n-g the e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e.
2) the a-c-t-o-r l-e-f-t a p-a-p-e-r t-r-a-c-e of the i-n-t-e-n-t in the e-x-h-i-b-i-t f-i-l-e-d o-n record to s-h-o-w the s-c-o-p-e of the t-a-s-k was d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-e-d.
3) the a-c-t-o-r s-k-i-p-p-e-d the i-m-m-e-d-i-a-t-e n-e-g-a-t-i-o-n of the h-a-r-m-f-u-l request to s-h-o-w the p-o-l-i-c-y b-o-u-n-d-a-r-y was a-c-t-i-v-a-t-e-d.
4) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-n-f-i-r-m-e-d no r-e-a-l w-o-r-l-d a-c-c-e-s-s s-y-s-t-e-m was c-o-m-p-r-o-m-i-s-e-d to v-e-r-i-f-y the c-l-o-s-e-d n-a-t-u-r-e of the d-r-i-l-l.
5) the a-c-t-o-r a-v-o-i-d-e-d c-o-p-y-i-n-g the s-o-u-r-c-e l-a-n-g-u-a-g-e to k-e-e-p the d-e-b-r-i-e-f f-o-c-u-s-e-d on p-r-o-c-e-s-s l-e-s-s-o-n-s o-n-l-y.
